skill.name: code-review-expert
skill.description: Structured code review guidance for architecture, quality, security, performance, and merge readiness.
skill.summary: Guides structured code reviews with prioritized quality, security, and architecture findings.
skill.author: BarisSozen

content.value_statement: Code reviews can miss architecture, quality, security, and product risks. This skill guides a structured review and returns prioritized findings.
actual_capabilities: Guides reviews through structure, architecture, modules, and functions.
Applies architect, product, QA, and UX review perspectives.
Prioritizes findings by critical, high, medium, and low severity.
Highlights security and performance concerns during deep review.
Provides a quick checklist for common code quality issues.
limitations: It depends on the code and context supplied by the user.
It does not execute tests, builds, or security scanners by itself.
It cannot confirm runtime behavior without logs or reproduction steps.
It is guidance for reviewers, not a replacement for maintainer judgment.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request Review
use_cases.description: Review a change before merge and identify correctness, maintainability, and release risks.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Architecture Choices
use_cases.description: Assess module boundaries, dependencies, and design tradeoffs before committing to an implementation.

use_cases.title: Audit Quality Before Release
use_cases.description: Check security, performance, validation, and error handling concerns before shipping a feature.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Small Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a focused code change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change for correctness, readability, and obvious risks. Prioritize findings by severity and include a short summary.

prompt_templates.title: Check Pull Request Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request for merge readiness. Assess tests, error handling, data validation, and maintainability concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Architecture Impact
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of design and module boundaries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this implementation from architecture, product, QA, and UX perspectives. Identify design risks and practical alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Perform Deep Risk Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a deep review focused on security, performance, reliability, and deployment risk. Separate blocking issues from follow-up work.

output_examples.input: A pull request that adds a new API endpoint and database write path.
output_examples.output: The review flags missing input validation as high severity, notes limited error handling, and recommends adding focused integration tests.

output_examples.input: A service refactor that moves business logic across modules.
output_examples.output: The review summarizes the architecture impact, identifies unclear ownership boundaries, and lists lower-risk cleanup tasks for later work.

output_examples.input: A release candidate with performance-sensitive changes.
output_examples.output: The review highlights potential latency issues, asks for benchmark evidence, and separates release blockers from backlog improvements.

best_practices: Provide the relevant diff, surrounding context, and the intended behavior.
Ask for severity-ranked findings when you need a merge decision.
Include tests, logs, and known constraints for more accurate review results.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a complete review without providing the changed code.
Do not treat suggestions as verified defects without checking the codebase.
Do not ignore project conventions when applying generic best practices.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews architecture, modules, functions, security, performance, tests, and general code quality.

faq.question: Can it approve a pull request?
faq.answer: It can recommend readiness, but the final approval should come from the project maintainer.

faq.question: Does it run tests?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and findings based on the context supplied by the user.

faq.question: How should I provide context?
faq.answer: Share the diff, related files, expected behavior, known risks, and any test results.

faq.question: Can it find security issues?
faq.answer: It can highlight likely security concerns, especially validation, secrets, injection, and unsafe data handling.

faq.question: Is it useful for architecture reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a top-down review path from architecture to modules and functions.
